name: Claude Usage
description:
Unofficial indicator for Claude subscription limits (5-hour session, weekly, per-model weekly, extra usage) and the API-equivalent cost of your Claude Code usage, broken down by day, model and project.

Requires Claude Code to be signed in (it reads the OAuth token Claude Code stores in ~/.claude/.credentials.json, read-only, never refreshed) and python3. Usage data comes from Claude Code's local logs. The menu opens on hover and stays open on click.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
